title: Peas and carrots, frozen, cooked, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Peas and carrots, frozen and ready to eat without added fat, are a blend of green peas and carrots that have been blanched and flash‑frozen. The process preserves most of the vitamins and minerals found in fresh vegetables, and the product is ready for consumption after heating.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peas and carrots are a common combination in baby foods because of their mild flavor and bright color.
Individual quick freezing (IQF) keeps vegetable cells intact, preventing large ice crystals from forming.
No added fat makes the product low‑calorie and suitable for weight‑management diets.
Carrots are an excellent source of beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
Peas provide a good amount of plant protein and fiber, contributing to satiety.

items.title: Rich in vitamin A
items.content: Carrots contain high levels of beta‑carotene, supporting vision, immune function, and skin health.

items.title: Source of plant protein
items.content: Peas deliver a complete set of essential amino acids useful for muscle maintenance and tissue repair.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion, helps regulate blood sugar, and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The absence of added fat makes this product suitable for low‑calorie eating plans.

items.title: Contains vitamin C and folate
items.content: Both vegetables are good sources of vitamin C and folate, important for immune health and DNA synthesis.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to peas; discontinue use if allergic reactions occur.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Certain brands may add a small amount of salt during processing; check the label if you need a low‑sodium diet.

items.title: Vitamin loss over long storage
items.content: While freezing retains most nutrients, prolonged storage can lead to modest reductions in vitamin levels.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product can be heated in the microwave (2‑3 minutes) or briefly boiled (3‑4 minutes). Use it as a side dish, or add to soups, stews, pasta, rice dishes, or stir‑fries.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. Once thawed, consume within 24 hours and do not refreeze.
